source_defects_reproduced: Original RpcCall result waits forever for a missing response
Original unknown-method tag gate can retain a request
Every attempted packet now reserves a distinct ID, including TX failure
new_behavior: Bounded handshake retry reuses one transport and one updater. RPC failure no longer triggers an MCU reset in idle setup/service.
actual_2607_observation: Read-only SWD repeated snapshots showed setup delay, then handshake, then repeated core tick reset. No hardware UART error was present in sampled LPUART ISR.
actual_2609_observation: Read-only SWD while unavailable showed 34 response timeouts, zero send timeouts, complete incoming get calls queued, and no sampled UART PE/FE/NE/ORE. No auto reset command remains on RPC begin failure.
linux_recovery: Published Arduino router0.5.3 $/serial/close and $/serial/open with /dev/ttyHS1 returned true. Does not require sudo, MCU reset, firmware change or motor commands.
limitation: This narrows the failure to RPC startup/stream state; a primary physical fault or exact Linux decoder state is not proven. USB and powerbank cold boot must be distinguished.
current_physical_state: J1 OFF, DMM<20V confirmed by user; Uno USB PC, Nucleo powerbank, 15V unchanged ON; sensor/motor wiring unchanged.
